method: warm-start large-neighbourhood search with symmetry group T (rotations of the tetrahedron, 12 elements) started from the Td-symmetric rule CA-C3-28-1133-PI-MPC: code/cubature_search.py --refine (orbit elimination and simulated annealing); minimised sum of w^2 with tools/minimize_l2.py; proven with tools/verify_rigorous.py; the weights were then minimised in the L2 norm under all moment equations with a penalty for nodes outside the domain and the symmetry kept (tools/minimize_l2.py)
